cp=Path('docs/checkpoints/2026-10-30/fixture-clearance-01'); root=Path('validation/feature-inputs/S4-FIXTURE-CLEARANCE-20261030-r2'); rows=[]

 for name in (['process-card.pdf','fixture-inspection.pdf'] if key=='clear-jaws' else ['fixture-inspection.pdf']):
  doc=fitz.open(root/key/name)
  for i,p in enumerate(doc):
   target=cp/(key+'-'+Path(name).stem+'-'+str(i+1)+'.png'); p.get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(1.25,1.25),alpha=False).save(target)
